MCPToolProvider~emfModel.name: emf_model_tool_provider
MCPToolProvider~emfModel.description: Tools to author Ecore metamodels and to create, populate, validate and serialize EMF model instances (from allow-listed or session-registered EPackages)

HttpMCPServerComponent~emfModel.server.name: osgi-emf-mcp-server
HttpMCPServerComponent~emfModel.server.instructions: Use this MCP server to author Ecore metamodels and to build EMF model instances. INSTANCES: start with list_metamodel and describe_eclass to discover the metamodel, then create_dataset + create_instance + modify_feature to build objects; inspect_dataset (includeRecipe=true) returns a replayable recipe; export_dataset serializes XMI or JSON; create_from_json builds a whole graph in one call; replay_recipe reproduces a dataset deterministically. AUTHORING: create_dataset then create_epackage + add_eclass/add_edatatype/add_eenum(+add_eenum_literal)/add_eattribute/add_ereference/add_eoperation(+add_eparameter)/add_eannotation, with add_etypeparameter and eGenericType/eGenericSuperTypes for generics; type references are <nsURI>#//<Name> (e.g. http://www.eclipse.org/emf/2002/Ecore#//EString) or a dataset objectId; register_package validates and registers the package so its classes become instantiable (list_registry/unregister_package manage it); export_dataset (format=xmi) yields the .ecore. IMPORT: import_ecore / import_instances re-load inline XMI to keep editing across prompts (import the .ecore before its instances). SECURITY: OSGi packages are visible only when allow-listed (deny-all); authored packages register only under allow-listed namespaces and must be dynamic; imported XMI is never dereferenced externally.
